description:
AML (Anti-Money Laundering) risk checks for addresses and transactions.

Actions:
• verify-address: Check if a blockchain address is flagged or associated with fraud, sanctions, ransomware, exploits, darknet markets, or other AML risk categories. Returns risk score, risk band, and the flagging sources.
• screen-transaction: Screen a transaction against AML data. Returns whether the transaction is flagged, its risk score/band, and the flagged participant addresses with their roles, scores, severities and categories.
• get-address-exposure: Get an address's exposure to risky entities/categories across the AML exposure graph. Params: blockchain, address. Costs 200,000 credits per request.
• list-address-exposure-paths: List the paths connecting an address to risky entities in the AML exposure graph. Params: blockchain, address; optional rootAddress (only return routes originating from this flagged root address), limit (1-50, defaults to 10), startingAfter (pagination cursor). Costs 100,000 credits per page - pass the response's next cursor back as startingAfter to fetch subsequent pages.

get-address-exposure and list-address-exposure-paths only support a subset of chains - see the blockchain parameter description.

Note: the credit cost of these endpoints is significant — see credits below.

Credits by action (source: OpenAPI):
• get-address-exposure: 200000
• list-address-exposure-paths: 100000
• screen-transaction: 500000
• verify-address: 200000

Credits are indicative only and may change at any time. The actual credits spent for each API request are returned in the response headers.

address.description: Blockchain address - required for verify-address, get-address-exposure, and list-address-exposure-paths

blockchain.description: Blockchain protocol - required for screen-transaction, get-address-exposure and list-address-exposure-paths. screen-transaction accepts: ethereum, ethereum-classic, binance-smart-chain, bitcoin, bitcoin-cash, dash, dogecoin, litecoin, arbitrum, polygon, avalanche, optimism, base, zcash, xrp, solana, tezos, kaspa, tron. get-address-exposure and list-address-exposure-paths accept only: ethereum, binance-smart-chain, ethereum-classic, polygon, tron, bitcoin, bitcoin-cash, litecoin, dogecoin, dash, zcash, xrp, solana

context.description: Optional context for the request - echoed back in response

limit.description: Number of exposure paths to return per page (1-50, defaults to 10) - applies to list-address-exposure-paths only

rootAddress.description: Only return routes that originate from this flagged root address (one of the roots[].rootAddress values returned by get-address-exposure) - optional, applies to list-address-exposure-paths only

startingAfter.description: Pagination cursor - pass the nextStartingAfter value from the previous response to fetch the next page; applies to list-address-exposure-paths only

transactionHash.description: Transaction hash to screen against AML data - required for screen-transaction

name: aml__aml
